payload.description:
## Context
Measurement for kanbus-1f97c7 found 0 rejected references and empty reason-code history. v1 therefore uses thin-history-safe heuristics (accepted-set similarity, mechanical unavailability, dedupe) and keeps uncertain as the default lane.

## Goal
Once operators have logged meaningful reject reason-codes (`out_of_scope`, `policy_exclusion`, etc.), calibrate likely-accept / likely-reject thresholds against holdout decisions and report accept-rate-by-lane drift. Do not introduce auto-accept.

## Acceptance
- Offline calibration report from accepted vs scope-negative rejected history
- Threshold updates only after measured lane accept-rate review
- Exploratory prospects remain exempt from history-based scoring
payload.title: Calibrate triage lanes once rejection reason-codes accumulate
